dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "As the Sacred Flame burns eternal, so too will our pursuit of the 'strongest' never cease."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "You have arrived at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame, the center of Natlan itself. This noticeboard will announce tournament rules, progress, and other announcements. If you wish to know more, peruse the relevant articles in more detail."

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Continue Reading

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Leave

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "This year's Pilgrimage will soon begin, and the relevant information will now be announced."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "There have been no major changes to the rules of this Pilgrimage as compared to previous iterations."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "First, all contestants must form teams that meet the requirements to participate in the first round."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "After the tournament has begun, each team must find Fire Towers and engage other teams in combat to obtain Contending Fire."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "After gathering sufficient Contending Fire within the time granted, the various teams must also bring it safely back to the Stadium."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "Optimizations have been made to the locations of the hot-air balloons from which contestants will be dropped into the arena and the overall duration of the tournament..."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "The teams at the top of the team stage rankings will be eligible to participate in the individual tournament. When the time comes, all contestants will be scattered across different venues, and lots will be drawn to determine match-ups."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "In these individual matches, both contestants must display all the combat skills they have and defeat the other party to score points."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "Finally, the five contestants with the highest scores will be eligible to participate in the Night Warden Wars."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "After registering, all contestants will receive a detailed guide, complete with rules. Please read it carefully and take note of all provisions to avoid any erroneous decision-making due to misinformation..."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
"Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame" Notice
dialogues.text: "After fierce contention, the winners of this year's Pilgrimage have been decided!"

dialogues.speaker: "Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame" Notice
dialogues.text: "With her sixth consecutive win... Chasca of the Flower-Feather Clan!"

dialogues.speaker: "Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame" Notice
dialogues.text: "She managed to turn the tides all by herself... Iansan of the Collective of Plenty!"

dialogues.speaker: "Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame" Notice
dialogues.text: "With an explosive comeback ten years in the making... Kaiulani of the People of the Springs!"

dialogues.speaker: "Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame" Notice
dialogues.text: "A seasoned and renowned warrior... Kibangu of the Scions of the Canopy!"

dialogues.speaker: "Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame" Notice
dialogues.text: "Last but not least... Finally living up to her true potential... Kachina of the Children of Echoes!"

dialogues.speaker: "Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame" Notice
dialogues.text: "These five champions shall step into the Night Kingdom and once more defeat the Abyss in another Night Warden War, seizing victory and glory for Natlan!"

dialogues.speaker: "Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame" Notice
dialogues.text: "Let us offer these valiant five our greatest praises and blessings!"

dialogues.speaker: "Pilgrimage of the Return of the Sacred Flame" Notice
Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: "The dust has settled upon this Night Warden War. Glory evermore to Natlan!"

dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: "Our warriors have obtained a great victory, heaping fresh wood upon the Sacred Flame!"

dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: "Despite the great dangers to themselves, and indeed, to 'Utha{RUBY#[D]Resilience}biti' Kachina in specific..."

dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: #"With the aid of warriors of the tribes, the outlander {NICKNAME}, and {M#his}{F#her} guide Paimon..."

dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: "All were preserved from peril and returned victorious!"

dialogues.speaker: Night Warden War Notice
dialogues.text: "Let us give them our most passionate applause and wondrous benedictions! Let us revel in yet another moment of glory for Natlan!"

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "The Stadium will undergo a period of maintenance after the Pilgrimage, and will not (in principle) be used for any other purpose."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: "Please note that engaging in 'exchanging pointers' at the Stadium's main arena or performing rehearsals for future tournaments without prior notice is prohibited."

dialogues.speaker: "Basin of Unnumbered Flames" Advertisement
dialogues.text: "All guests are welcome to visit other areas at the Basin of Unnumbered Flames—"

dialogues.speaker: "Basin of Unnumbered Flames" Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The Chuwen Fair is packed full of shops. Here, you can enjoy Natlan's specialties and local delicacies. It's the perfect spot for you to rest up!"

dialogues.speaker: "Basin of Unnumbered Flames" Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The Weary Inn and Zakan's Street Bites are great for both flavor and serving size!"

dialogues.speaker: "Basin of Unnumbered Flames" Advertisement
dialogues.text: "And should you like to purchase armor or forge weapons, the Temple of Pax is an absolute must."

dialogues.speaker: "Basin of Unnumbered Flames" Advertisement
dialogues.text: "The Salutary Furnace is the apex of Natlan weapon forging technology, utilizing the greatest ore and mineral products from the Children of Echoes. The quality and shape of their work is much-praised by warriors!"

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Uh, I applied to meet with the Pyro Archon last week and discuss how to promote a new type of sport and fitness movement..."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "Last week? She went to take part in a fitness invitational contest at the invitation of the Collective of Plenty. It seems she did not have the time to respond to your message. Please, do..."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Oh, I'm from the Collective of Plenty, actually. She said that she'd try the new fitness program herself, before picking the appropriate weight for each training stage."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "But it's been a week, and she hasn't sent me a reply. I would just like to know... How's she finding the experience?"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "Considering the number of barbell plates outside her training room, we suspect that our Archon will be in training for some time."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "H—Huh? Wait, then... how is she doing right now?"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "She is presently shooting for a new weight, and she just went outside to get some new weightlifting belts, humming all the way. Would you... like to wait a while longer?"

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Alright. I'll head back and bring a merchant who sells those belts with me next time..."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Could I ask what the Pyro Archon thinks of the Saurian Cookies we sent her?"

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Could we ask for her opinion on them?"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "She loves them! In fact, she's had quite a few. If she had to have one teeny-tiny criticism of them, it's that they're just the slightest bit on the dry side."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Uhh... Well, they're for little Saurians, so..."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "Yes, and that's why she's gone off into the wild to look for wild Saurians."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "'Wild Saurians tend to be very sensitive to food, so I'll find the most energetic of the lot and feed it some,' so she said."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Then... You don't happen to know where she is now, do you?"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "According to her previous plan, she should have arrived in the vicinity of Teticpac Peak. Please exercise some patience."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "What sort of Saurian will she be looking for...?"

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Apologies. I'm a merchant from the store next door. Could I ask what the Speaker's Chamber has been doing lately?"

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "We often hear dull thudding, and the ground will tremble slightly from time to time... Is it some sort of earthquake? Or is the building going to collapse?"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "Very sorry! Please rest assured that earthquakes don't happen around here, and the building is very stable."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "The tremors and dull thuds you heard are from the Pyro Archon's daily routine training."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "The weight of the barbells used by the Pyro Archon are very heavy, which is why they make a loud noise when they fall to the ground. We will speak to her on the topic. Thank you for your understanding!"

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Might I... ask how much weight is needed to make such a noise...? Anyway, since it's so heavy, wouldn't it be better if she trained outdoors instead?"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "She said that she sometimes loses control out in the wild, and tends to use weights that are... Let's call them somewhat overboard."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "Since the last incident, where she almost smashed a certain volcano with a giant rock, causing a landslide, she has endeavored to refrain from further outdoor training."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "...I see. In that case, I, too, suggest that she remain indoors when training."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "Thank you for your kind understanding. We will send you a set of earplugs."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "...Using woven scrolls to record fictional novels? You might be barking up the wrong tree. We are the Speaker's Chamber, not the Masters of the Night-Wind, nor are we a publishing company."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Uh, no, what we've actually done is hire a famous external novelist. We'd like to write an interesting light novel for our Pyro Archon."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "The novel is largely complete at this point, and we'd like to create a promotion plan that has a distinctly 'Natlan' flavor to it..."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "So, that's why you'd like this novel woven into a scroll, yes?"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Reply
dialogues.text: "Hmmm. That does sound quite interesting! We'll inform the Pyro Archon about this..."

dialogues.speaker: Pyro Archon's Reply
dialogues.text: "Well, I think that's a great idea. I'll hit Citlali up later. She might be interested, too."

dialogues.speaker: Pyro Archon's Reply
dialogues.text: "That said, do let me have a look at the book first, would you? I'd be interested to know what outlanders think of me..."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber Announcement
dialogues.text: "Today is the Speaker's Chamber Question-and-Answer Day. Please leave your queries here in an orderly fashion, and our Pyro Archon will answer them in order."

dialogues.speaker: Guest Message
dialogues.text: "Big Sis Lady Mavuika! What are your glasses made of? Why don't they get burned by fire? I asked Dad, Mom, and Big Sis, but none of them know..."

dialogues.speaker: Pyro Archon's Reply
dialogues.text: "My sunglasses? I had 'em custom-made from Xilonen. If you want a pair, too, kiddo, you can ask her. I'm sure she's happy to help."

dialogues.speaker: Another Guest's Message
dialogues.text: "Lady Archon. I'm an athlete, but I've been in subpar form lately, and a breakthrough has eluded me constantly."

dialogues.speaker: Another Guest's Message
dialogues.text: "...I sometimes wonder if I simply... lack talent. If I should give up. Dear Archon, could you give me some advice?"

dialogues.speaker: Pyro Archon's Reply
dialogues.text: "If you wish to gain fame and wealth through 'sport,' then I urge you to work within your limits and be realistic about your chances."

dialogues.speaker: Pyro Archon's Reply
dialogues.text: "If you're in this line because you love it, however, keep pushing on."

dialogues.speaker: Pyro Archon's Reply
dialogues.text: "The sweat you have poured out and the pain you've endured will serve as the stepping stones toward your victory."

dialogues.speaker: Stadium of the Sacred Flame Notice
dialogues.text: Abyssal Monsters have appeared in huge numbers throughout Natlan. All warriors and willing hands reading this announcement, please head to the battlefield to eliminate these creatures and rescue the civilians!

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Children of Natlan, hear my voice."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini's story ends here for now, but the legacy of hope must go on."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Yours is the age where heroes embark on their own paths."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "May the Lord of the Night strengthen your resolve. May the Ode of Resurrection keep you on your path."

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "My help me find my dad — he hasn't returned home! He's a doctor, and before he left, he said he was going to Quahuacan Cliff to rescue someone."

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "My father's easy to recognize. His face and arms have scars from where he was attacked by a Saurian."

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "If anyone sees him, please tell him to come home and eat. My mom and I haven't seen him in over a month! We miss him so much! Please help us!"

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Name: Umatica (female, 50 years old). A retired courier, recently recalled by the Courier's Longhouse, she was responsible for relaying messages between the Scions of the Canopy and the Stadium of the Sacred Flame."

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "She was last seen on the road while delivering a message to the Stadium of the Sacred Flame. She has not returned since and no information regarding her whereabouts has been forthcoming."

dialogues.speaker: Missing Person Poster
dialogues.text: "Anyone who may have information that can help is kindly requested to contact the Speaker's Chamber or any passing courier. Please help us get her home."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber
dialogues.text: "Emergency Notice: Humans or Saurians who have been exposed to Abyssal energy and are experiencing symptoms such as long-term emotional instability, a lack of vigor, or mental disarray, may have contracted a malady known as Abyssal Corrosion Syndrome."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber
dialogues.text: "This affliction may cause hallucinations or mental breakdowns and is extremely dangerous to those infected."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber
dialogues.text: "If any of your family or friends show the above symptoms, please immediately contact the doctors at the Stadium of the Sacred Flame. Any delay in seeking medical treatment may exacerbate the patient's condition."

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber
dialogues.text: "No matter how long the night, the dawn will always come. No matter how weak the flames, the fire will never die!"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber
dialogues.text: "Warriors of Natlan, rejoice! The Abyss has been defeated. Peace has arrived. We have attained victory once more!"

dialogues.speaker: Speaker's Chamber
dialogues.text: "Warriors of Natlan, rejoice! For the Pyro Archon, for Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini —the hero from a distant land — and for all those who sacrificed themselves so that we could see this day, rejoice!"
